text: {"final": {"summary": "In inventory/stock.py's reserve_stock, added a warehouse_id format check before the existing SKU/qty/hold_hours validations and before any ledger load/save: it imports is_valid_warehouse_id from core/ids.py and raises ValueError(f\"invalid warehouse id {warehouse_id!r}\") when the code is malformed or uses an unknown region. Because the check runs first, rejected codes (e.g. \"WH7\") record nothing in the ledger, while valid codes like \"WH-HGL-07\" pass unchanged.", "done_steps": ["P1"]}}
